title: Retrieval is Cheap, Show Me the Code: Executable Multi-Hop Reasoning for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
authors: Jiashuo Sun; Jimeng Shi; Yixuan Xie; Saizhuo Wang; Jash Rajesh Parekh; Pengcheng Jiang; Zhiyi Shi; Jiajun Fan; Qinglong Zheng; Peiran Li; Shaowen Wang; Ge Liu; Jiawei Han
why_relevant: Proposes executable program-based multi-hop RAG to reduce entity drift and reasoning errors, tangentially related to retrieval reliability.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on multi-hop reasoning structure rather than robustness to noise, conflict, adversarial evidence, or calibration.
